name: WANTED: Ghostmaw
summary: Wheatley fears a phantom crocolisk called Ghostmaw is taking his prized ponies along the rivers. He waits at Farholde Keep until someone brings him the beast’s fang.

sections.title: Wheatley’s Concern
sections.body: Wheatley has stopped moving his horses through the glades because of reports of Ghostmaw along the rivers. The crocolisk is said to be three times the size of an ordinary one and twice as mean. Bring Wheatley Ghostmaw’s fang so he can know it is safe to travel again.

faq.answer: Ghostmaw is a mysterious phantom crocolisk reported along the rivers, said to be far larger and meaner than an ordinary crocolisk.

faq.q: Why has Wheatley stopped moving his horses?
faq.answer: Wheatley fears Ghostmaw may snap up his prized ponies, so he is staying put until the beast is dealt with.

faq.q: What does Wheatley want brought to him?
faq.answer: Wheatley asks for Ghostmaw’s fang as proof that the crocolisk is no longer a danger to travel.

faq.q: Where should I bring Ghostmaw’s fang?
faq.answer: Bring Ghostmaw’s fang to Wheatley at Farholde Keep.
